data_collection.declaration: The app collects only the minimum data required to provide its declared functionality. No third-party advertising SDKs are bundled.

scopes.data_handling: Encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3); encrypted at rest; retained while account is active.

scopes.type: In-app actions (audit events: pipeline start, retry, acknowledge)
scopes.data_handling: Retained for up to 365 days; encrypted at rest; self-hosted deployments may disable entirely.
Self-hosted deployments may disable entirely. Managed deployments use a SOC2-Type-II sub-processor.

data_sharing.rationale: All data stays within the gm-console deployment you operate. No third-party advertisers. Sub-processors are listed at docs/commercial/SUB_PROCESSORS.md (Cloudflare edge, AWS k8s control plane in ap-northeast-1, GitHub source hosting, Sentry error tracking opt-in only, Postmark transactional email).

data_handling.deletion_method: Email privacy@kanvas.dev OR self-service in a future v0.4.0 build (path tracked in docs/upstream/).

data_retention.account_info: While the account is active + 30 days after deletion request.
data_retention.crash_logs: 30 days rolling window in managed deployments; can be set shorter in self-hosted.
